It looks like this pull request was opened against `element-hq/element-x-android` by mistake (for instance, while syncing a fork, or with changes specific to a rebranded fork such as a new app name or icon).

We are closing it. If you maintain a fork, make sure your pull requests and sync workflows target your own repository. If you do want to contribute a change to Element X, please read our [contributing guide](https://github.com/element-hq/element-x-android/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md) and open a dedicated pull request from a branch created from `develop`.
